data.headline: EONR flags 2025 10-K non-reliance after expense error

claims.text: EON said its 2025 Form 10-K should no longer be relied upon.

citation.quote: As a result, management of the Company determined on October 8, 2026 that the Company’s 2025 Form 10-K filed with the SEC on September 28, 2026 (the “Affected Period”) should no longer be relied upon.

claims.text: EON said 2025 depletion, depreciation and amortization expense was overstated by $3,540,000 and net loss decreased by $2,632,000.

citation.quote: The depletion, depreciation and amortization expense for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 was overstated by $3,540,000 and the net loss decreased by $2,632,000 (an increase in overall earnings for the Company).

claims.text: The restatement is non-cash and will not affect cash flows, cash, cash equivalents or marketable investments.

citation.quote: This restatement is non-cash in nature and will have no impact on the Company’s cash flows or cash, cash equivalents and marketable investments.

claims.text: EON’s filing notes that it had already restated its audited consolidated financial statements for 2024.

citation.quote: As previously disclosed, we restated our audited consolidated financial statements as of December 31, 2024 and for the year ended December 31, 2024.
